# Healthcare HH Insights

> Free tools and guides for NHS trusts, health boards, ambulance trusts and independent hospitals in England, Scotland and Wales: a half-hourly (HH) electricity analyser (base load, day and night use, out-of-hours use in clinics and offices, peaks against agreed supply capacity and headroom for heat pumps, EV charging and CHP removal, unusual days, solar self-consumption, PDF and Excel reports), a solar PV calculator fed by the measured profile, and sourced guides to net zero targets, funding, heat decarbonisation, moving away from gas CHP, electrical capacity, solar and energy efficiency on healthcare estates.

Independent: not part of, or endorsed by, the NHS.

Operated by Kinetic Energy Consulting. Free to use, no sign-up. The analyser runs entirely in the browser: meter data is never uploaded.

Scope: healthcare estates, NHS and independent sector. Results are indicative estimates from the data loaded: costs are energy cost at the rates entered, not guaranteed savings, and whole-site data shows when energy is used, not which equipment uses it. The method is set out on the How it works page.

Method in brief: base load is the 5th percentile of valid half-hourly demand; out-of-hours (closed-hours) excess is energy used outside the opening hours above that base load; missing readings are left out, never counted as zero; annual figures are scaled from valid hours and withheld under 180 days of data; kVA is kW divided by an assumed power factor.

## Tools

- [Analyser](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/analyser/): the half-hourly analyser, in the browser.
- [Solar calculator](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/solar-calculator): solar PV sizing, cost, payback and PPA comparison over 25 years; opens with the analyser's measured share of output used on site.

## Core pages

- [Half-hourly electricity analysis and solar for healthcare estates](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/): Free half-hourly analyser and solar calculator for NHS and independent healthcare estates: upload HH data, see base load, peaks and heat pump headroom, size solar from the measured profile, download reports; analysis runs in the browser.
- [How it works](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/how-it-works): The method in full: reading files, data checks, opening hours (hospital 24-7 preset), base load (5th percentile), closed-hours excess, costs, annualisation, findings, capacity and headroom, solar hand-off, and limits.
- [Questions and answers](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/faq): Who it is for, not an NHS tool, 24-hour sites, information governance, the solar hand-off, heat pumps, gas, cost, privacy and what the results mean.
- [Contact](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/contact): Enquiries to Kinetic Energy Consulting, which runs the site.
- [Sample half-hourly electricity report for an office](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/sample-report): A sample report for a made-up office: 33% of use while closed, £2,776 a year above base load, base load 2.6 kW, findings and what could be saved.
- [About Healthcare HH Insights and Paul Johnston](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/about): Who runs the site (Kinetic Energy Consulting, Managing Director Paul Johnston), why the analyser is free, and how the guides are sourced and checked.
- [Solar sizing from half-hourly data](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/solar): How half-hourly data shows how much solar a site would use, and how the analyser passes that to the solar calculator to size the system.

## Guides

- [How to get your half-hourly electricity data](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/get-your-data): Who holds half-hourly data, what to ask your supplier for, the file layouts the analyser reads, and what to do if your supplier cannot provide it.
- [Decarbonising healthcare estates: the challenge and where to start](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/healthcare-estates-decarbonisation): The decarbonisation challenge for healthcare estates: gas heat is the biggest source; targets, PSDS ending, grid capacity, 24/7 operation and falling grid carbon; a six-step order of work starting with half-hourly data.
- [NHS net zero targets in England, Scotland and Wales](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/nhs-net-zero-targets): NHS England net zero 2040 (direct) and 2045 (supply chain); NHS Scotland net zero 2040, renewable heat in NHS-owned buildings by 2038, buildings minus 75%; NHS Wales 16% by 2025 and 34% by 2030, no new fossil CHP and all decommissioned by 2035; supplier carbon reduction plans; IHPN 2035.
- [Funding for NHS and healthcare decarbonisation projects in 2026](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/decarbonisation-funding): Healthcare decarbonisation funding: PSDS no new commitments (Phase 4 to March 2028, £510/tCO2e cap); GBE £100m NHS solar (2025), 162 sites done and £25m for 40 more (May 2026); £74m for 82 trusts (Feb 2026); Scotland Public Sector Heat Decarbonisation Fund; Wales Invest to Save; PPAs and EPCs.
- [Heat decarbonisation for hospitals: heat pumps, steam and flow temperatures](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/heat-decarbonisation): Hospital heat decarbonisation: heat decarbonisation plans (whole building approach, electrical capacity section), lowering flow temperatures, steam to point-of-use, hot water safety under HTM 04-01, heat recovery from cooling, heat network zoning, and the electrical load (1 MW heat at efficiency 2.5 needs about 400 kW).
- [Moving away from gas CHP in hospitals: carbon, cost and electrical capacity](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/moving-away-from-chp): Gas CHP versus grid in 2026: gas 0.182 and grid 0.131 kgCO2e/kWh; with 35%/45% CHP efficiencies, CHP 0.182 kg vs grid plus boiler 0.137 kg vs grid plus heat pump 0.069 kg per kWh of gas; NHS Wales decommission fossil CHP by 2035; removing CHP raises grid import by its output (1 MW is about 1,050 kVA).
- [Electrical capacity for hospital electrification: heat pumps, EV charging and CHP](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/hospital-electrical-capacity): Hospital electrical headroom: agreed supply capacity (kVA) minus winter peak (kW/power factor); test heat pump input (1 MW heat at efficiency 2.5 is about 400 kW), CHP removal (1 MW is about 1,050 kVA) and EV charging; options if short; resilience and HTM 06-01.
- [Solar for NHS trusts, health boards and private hospitals](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/solar-on-healthcare-estates): Solar on healthcare estates: 24/7 hospitals use 90%+ of a well-sized system, clinics 55 to 80%; measure share used on site in the analyser and pass it to the solar calculator; roofs, car park canopies, ground mounts, helipad glare; G99 and resilience; GBE NHS solar funding and PPAs.
- [Energy efficiency in hospitals: where the quick wins are](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/hospital-energy-efficiency): Hospital energy efficiency: theatre ventilation setback (HTM 03-01, NHS Estates Technical Bulletin 2026/1), BMS schedules for non-clinical areas, LED with controls, steam traps and insulation, variable speed drives, base load steps, and proving savings with half-hourly data.
- [ERIC, EFPMS and benchmarking energy use in NHS estates](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/estates-returns-and-benchmarking): NHS estates reporting: ERIC (England, mandatory, £14.4bn estate running cost 2025/26, acute EUI about 211 kWh/m² in 2024/25), EFPMS (Wales, includes CHP), Scottish board sustainability reports; comparing fairly; what half-hourly data adds.
- [Worked example: a year of half-hourly data for an admin building](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/example-office-analysis): A small office run through the analyser: 33% of use while closed, £2,776 a year above base load, almost half on Saturdays; base load 2.6 kW; 67% of a 40 kVA supply.
- [Out-of-hours electricity use: how to find and cut it](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/out-of-hours-electricity): What out-of-hours electricity use is, how to find it in half-hourly data (opening hours, heatmap, day types, start and end of the day), common causes, fixes and who to involve.
- [Base load electricity: what it is and how to cut it](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/base-load): What base load is, how to measure it from half-hourly data (5th percentile, not the minimum), what makes it up, how to reduce it; 1 kW all year is 8,760 kWh.
- [Supply capacity and kVA: room for heat pumps and EVs](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/supply-capacity): Agreed supply capacity in kVA, kW to kVA via power factor, headroom from half-hourly peaks with a safety margin, and checking heat pumps and EV charging.
- [How to read a half-hourly electricity heatmap](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/reading-a-heatmap): How to read a half-hourly heatmap (days across, time of day down, colour for demand) and the patterns that point to waste.
- [How to prove an energy saving worked, with half-hourly data](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/proving-savings): Proving a saving with half-hourly data: matched before-and-after periods, the right measure for the change, weather effects, and the analyser tools.
- [Market-wide half-hourly settlement (MHHS) explained](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/half-hourly-settlement): Market-wide half-hourly settlement: Ofgem decision 20 April 2021; migration began 21 October 2025, due complete 7 May 2027; four-month settlement timetable from 2 July 2027; microbusinesses cannot opt out.
- [Glossary of half-hourly electricity terms](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/glossary): Definitions: base load, closed-hours excess, kW, kWh, kVA, power factor, MPAN, profile class, agreed supply capacity, settlement, MHHS, DUoS, TNUoS, BSUoS, Renewables Obligation, CfD, Capacity Market, nuclear RAB, CCL, red/amber/green bands and more.
- [Guides for healthcare estates: decarbonisation, solar and half-hourly data](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/guides): Index of guides.
- [How the solar calculator works: method and assumptions](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/solar-calculator-method): How the calculator estimates system size, generation, savings and payback: postcode sunshine from SAP 10.3, degradation, self-consumption and export.
- [How much does solar cost for hospitals and large sites?](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/solar-cost): Installed cost per kWp for pitched roof, flat roof, ground mount and solar carports, what the price includes and excludes, and a worked example.
- [How long does solar take to pay back on a hospital or healthcare site?](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/solar-payback): Typical payback for UK commercial solar, the five things that move it, and a worked example for a 509 kWp warehouse roof with the full figures.
- [Solar planning permission and grid connection for healthcare sites](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/solar-planning-and-grid): UK commercial solar hurdles: DNO grid connection under G98 and G99, export limits, permitted development, planning, roof condition and leases.
- [Paying for solar: buy, finance, lease or a PPA](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/paying-for-solar): How UK organisations pay for solar: buying outright, asset finance, leasing and PPAs, plus tax allowances, VAT, business rates and public funding.
- [How much electricity will solar panels generate?](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/solar-generation): Annual generation per kWp for each UK region, where the SAP 10.3 figures come from, and how to turn roof area into kilowatt hours.
- [Half-hourly electricity data from British Gas Business](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/half-hourly-data-british-gas): British Gas Business half-hourly data: Energy360 DataView (free, smart meter customers, request via chat, login within 10 working days); brokers need authorisation; up to 12 months free on request under government rules.
- [Half-hourly electricity data from EDF (business)](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/half-hourly-data-edf): EDF business half-hourly data: MyBusiness Data Analysis (4 MPANs) and Data Export (up to 350,000 records, about 20 MPANs for a year, CSV or Excel); small business Energy Hub with smart meter data preference set to half-hourly.
- [Half-hourly electricity data from E.ON Next](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/half-hourly-data-eon-next): E.ON Next business half-hourly data: no self-service download described publicly; profile class 00 check; data collector holds readings; Optimum included with E.ON data collection; up to 12 months free on request.
- [Half-hourly data from npower Business Solutions](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/half-hourly-data-npower-business-solutions): npower Business Solutions half-hourly data: Dashboard Meters section, "Download Half-Hourly (HH) data consumption", last 12 months; or email the Metering Team at nbssmart@npower.com.
- [Half-hourly electricity data from TotalEnergies](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/half-hourly-data-totalenergies): TotalEnergies Gas & Power half-hourly data: TotalEnergies Insights portal (from 1 October 2024, up to 12 months, smart and AMR meters not half-hourly settled, profile classes 1-8); access via the Half-Hourly Data Request Form.
- [Reading your MPAN: profile class and network region](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/mpan-profile-class): The MPAN supply number: bottom line is the 13-digit MPAN (distributor ID 10-23 identifies the network region, unique reference, check digit); top line profile class 00-08, MTC, LLFC; under MHHS profile classes are removed and migrated meters show 00.
- [Electricity benchmarks by sector: kWh per m² a year](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/electricity-benchmarks): Electricity benchmarks per m² (gross internal area) by sector from BEES 2014-15: offices median 88 kWh/m² (with other fuels) or 124 (all-electric); full quartile ranges for nine sectors; DEC operational rating 100 is typical, based on CIBSE TM46 benchmarks.
- [What's in a business electricity price?](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/business-electricity-price): Components of a UK business electricity price; worked 2026/27 example for a 500 MWh site: published network and policy charges about 9.3p/kWh, about a third of the 27.67p/kWh average delivered price (DESNZ, Q2 2026).
- [Non-energy charges on business electricity bills, explained](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/non-energy-charges): Non-energy charges explained with 2026/27 rates: TNUoS bands (LV1-LV4 £5.80-£38.18/site/day), DUoS time bands, BSUoS £13.74/£12.49/MWh, RO £32.73/MWh, CfD £0-£10.56/MWh, Capacity Market (4-7pm winter working days), nuclear RAB, FiT, CCL 0.801p/kWh, VAT.
- [UK business electricity prices, 2015 to 2026](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/electricity-prices-ten-years): UK business electricity prices 2015-2025 by size band (DESNZ QEP 3.4.2): 500-1,999 MWh band 10.9p (2015), 15.8p (2021), 32.2p (2023), 28.3p/kWh (2025); wholesale history from Ofgem; drivers: wind, gas and carbon, European prices.
- [Where non-energy electricity costs are heading from 2027](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/non-energy-costs-outlook): Outlook for UK non-energy electricity costs: BSUoS draft £21.67/MWh (Apr-Sep 2027) and £18.42/MWh (Oct 2027-Mar 2028); RO 0.369 ROC/MWh 2027/28 (0.394 with BICS); CCL 0.827p/kWh from April 2027 then frozen; CfD £2.98/MWh Q1 2027; ED3 network price control from 2028.

- [Community and mental health sites: half-hourly electricity, capacity and solar](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/community-and-mental-health): Community and mental health sites: what normal half-hourly demand looks like, what to check first, how to set the hours, and the capacity and solar questions.
- [Health centres, clinics and GP premises: half-hourly electricity, capacity and solar](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/health-centres-and-clinics): Health centres, clinics and GP premises: what normal half-hourly demand looks like, what to check first, how to set the hours, and the capacity and solar questions.
- [Ambulance stations and fleet depots: half-hourly electricity, capacity and solar](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/ambulance-stations-and-fleet): Ambulance stations and fleet depots: what normal half-hourly demand looks like, what to check first, how to set the hours, and the capacity and solar questions.
- [Healthcare settings: what to look for in your data](https://healthcarehhinsights.co.uk/sectors): Index of healthcare settings pages.
